item.title: Penn State Replaces Delaware With Maine on 2027 Football Schedule
item.description: Updated Jan. 22, 2025. Penn State has a new opponent on its 2027 schedule. According to a release from Delaware, the two programs "mutually agreed to cancel" a game slated for Sept. 11, 2027, leaving a hole in the Nittany Lions' nonconference slate. Instead, Penn State will face Maine, according to a report by Matt Fortuna, while the Blue Hens will instead face another Big Ten team in Illinois. item.title: Trump Administration Drops Legal Appeal Over Anti-DEI Funding Threat to Schools and Colleges
item.description: WASHINGTON (AP) — The Trump administration is dropping its appeal of a federal court ruling that blocked a campaign against diversity, equity, and inclusion threatening federal funding to the nation's schools and colleges. The Education Department, in a court filing Wednesday, moved to dismiss its appeal. item.description: The Center for the Performing Arts Spotlight Collective will usher in the return of rock to Eisenhower Auditorium with online-viral band The Paradox. item.title: Fullington Offering Shuttle Service for Penn State Men’s Hockey Game at Beaver Stadium
item.description: Fans will have another way to get to the Penn State men's hockey team's historic game at Beaver Stadium on Jan. 31. Fullington Trailways will operate multiple shuttle routes starting at 10 a.m., ahead of the 1 p.m. puck drop against Michigan State. Shuttles servicing multiple pickup points will run through the first period then resume in the third period until 90 minutes after the game. item.title: Man Sentenced to Prison After Attempting to Hire Inmates to Kill Centre County Drug Case Informant
item.description: A man who Centre County prosecutors said twice tried to hire fellow jail inmates to murder an informant in a drug case has been sentenced to years in prison. Mark C. Hackett, 64, of Clearfield County, was sentenced by Centre County Judge Julia Rater last week to eight to 16 years in state prison, plus another five years for a parole violation, after pleading no contest to a charge of solicitation of murder and guilty to one felony count of delivering methamphetamine. item.title: Penn State Men’s Basketball Embarrassed by Wisconsin in Return to Rec Hall
item.description: Penn State returned to its old stomping grounds inside Rec Hall for the annual “Return to Rec” game against Wisconsin on Thursday night.
